rows.label: expt:devperf:design-correspondence
rows.measurement: Five paired runs on the same full corpus on the compute node measured 26.123, 25.903, 28.599, 25.870 and 26.643 seconds before, and 0.249, 0.245, 0.257, 0.250 and 0.282 seconds after; the rounded up maximum after is 283 milliseconds. Exact commands, source identity and pressure indicators remain in the untracked measurement artifacts
rows.name: design-correspondence
rows.placement: required per-change gate under the ordinary-check budget
rows.reason: Profiling attributed 32.550 of 32.973 instrumented seconds to 71175 regular-expression searches, including repeated compilation. One compiled union now searches every tracked first-party document and template with the same literal labels and backtick boundaries. The source projections, inventories and graph checks remain intact; an exhaustive controlled predicate comparison and the existing refusal tests retain the evidence. Every paired optimized sample fits the ordinary budget.
rows.settlement: Withdrawn because indexing removed the expensive repeated scan without weakening its predicate. This entry records the withdrawal and preserves the historical citation target; it grants no exception

rows.name: pn-interchange::regexp::tests::nullable_counted_membership_20
rows.operation: nullable counted repetition oracle and corrected matcher at count twenty
rows.reason: The approximately 2.1-fold increase is the accepted cost of counted-search correctness: exact membership takes priority over oracle speed. The 200 ms warning budget rounds the recorded gate cost upward; it changes no predicate, retry or timeout.
rows.settlement: Accepted correctness cost; revisit on matcher or fixture changes without weakening membership evidence

The third sample retained a metric-contention comparison failure; all stream records were delivered. This timing is not a passing verdict.
rows.name: observation-runtime
rows.placement: required fast-tier observation runtime workload; suite and enclosing gate step report independently, without adding their overlapping durations
rows.reason: Twenty-five percent above the largest measured wall, rounded up to a whole second. The former five-second allowance was never a measured baseline for this traced workload; the general pure-suite allowance remains unchanged.
rows.settlement: Re-measure on workload or representation changes; timing excess never changes verdicts, retries, skips or termination. Retain metric-contention comparison failures independently.
